# Proqi 0.12.0

Organize mixed boards through the public API, hide optional footer controls,
and keep automatic input recovery available after executable upgrades.

## Breaking changes and upgrade

This release upgrades the database to schema 19 and storage protocol 18.
Migration is automatic and creates a backup before applying changes. Older
Proqi binaries cannot open the upgraded database. If startup reports older
running sessions as migration blockers, close those sessions cleanly and retry
with the updated executable. Do not delete the database or its lock files.

The owner-control protocol advances to 11. The public JSON schema remains at 1,
with additive operations and capability reporting. Scripts and agents should
inspect `proqi --json capabilities` before using the new commands.

## Highlights

- Automate mixed boards with `items insert-separator`, `items move`,
  `items delete`, and `items duplicate`. Commands use typed thought and
  separator identities and work with active and inactive sessions.
- Transform thought text through `thoughts split`, `thoughts extract`,
  `thoughts merge`, and `thoughts reflow`, with expected-content hashes to
  reject stale edits. Updated agent skills describe the supported operations.
- Retry newly recorded semantic operations with the same operation identity
  after restart or history compaction without applying them twice. Distinct
  requests remain distinguishable, including different extraction ranges in
  repeated text. Existing receipts retain conservative compatibility checks.
- Set `footer_hidden = true` to hide optional persistent footer chrome and
  reclaim space. Plain `h` toggles it temporarily in Board mode, including the
  insertion boundary, without writing configuration. Compose and Edit retain
  literal `h`; the session Browser follows startup configuration. Required
  durability, recovery, warning, and Screenshot Inbox status stays visible.
- Complete 19 shared Codex and Claude commands at the start of a thought,
  including `/clear`, `/compact`, `/review`, and `/status`. Choosing a
  completion inserts text; it does not execute the command. In combined
  submissions, only `/plan` and `/goal` are stripped from later thoughts;
  other shared commands and their arguments are preserved.
- Resume normally after an executable upgrade without stale recovery lineage
  disabling future automatic input-stall recovery. Automatic restarts retain
  strict identity checks and the existing two-attempt limit per ten minutes.
  Content-free diagnostics now identify input-reader stages and progress gaps.
- Find task-oriented workflows and command references in the
  [user guides](https://oborchers.github.io/proqi/), covering editing, selection,
  attachments, delivery, sessions, recovery, shortcuts, and configuration.

## Install

For an existing Homebrew installation:

```shell
brew update
brew upgrade --formula oborchers/tap/proqi
```

## Known limitations

- The underlying terminal-input stall is not fixed by this release. Recovery
  remains bounded, and a genuinely unavailable terminal may require manual
  session resume.
- Shared command completion requires a verified compatible adjacent Codex or
  Claude agent. Actual command availability depends on the harness version
  and enabled features.
- Public API support does not provide remote control of spatial UI behavior
  or host clipboard acquisition.
- Older Proqi versions may reject the new `footer_hidden` configuration key.
  Remove it before using an older version with a compatible separate state root.
